name: Jayapura
routes: See city-8686-jayapura.json attemptedRoutes and freshResearch.queries; all executed discovery and bounded anonymous requests are recorded there with outcomes.
queryAndRequestOutcome: English and Indonesian discovery found the official ATR/BPN ATLAS surface and a Jayapura-specific municipal Smart Asset map. The municipal land endpoint returned 115 point assets over TLS-verified anonymous GET; it did not return parcel polygons. ATLAS loaded but no safe Jayapura cadastral feature response was obtained.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Municipal page JavaScript exposed /api/lands/geojson; no cadastral viewer config observed.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: No explicit CRS member; GeoJSON coordinates observed as [longitude, latitude].
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: properties.id observed for municipal asset points; not qualified as a cadastral parcel identity.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if later exposed and source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry if later exposed

qualification.reason: Only municipal asset points were qualified; no full cadastral parcel polygon plus stable parcel identity was obtained. Local map evidence does not establish cadastral adapter readiness.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point preserved; no coordinate shift.
